articles.title: Phillies’ quest to clinch a playoff spot stalls again with 5-1 loss to the Brewers
articles.description: The Phillies’ magic number remains two with a weekend series against the AL-leading Rays left to lock up a spot in the postseason.

articles.description: The Phillies finished 0-for-12 with runners in scoring position and Aaron Nola allowed four runs across six innings.

articles.title: Five outs from Alex McFarlane, three eighth-inning runs move Phillies closer to a playoff berth
articles.description: Bryson Stott delivered the big hit, an RBI double that ended up scoring two on an error and Brandon Marsh tacked on an RBI double to break the tie with two out in the eighth.

articles.title: Phillies Extra: Larry Andersen on the big question for a long playoff run
articles.description: As the postseason looms, let’s talk about the Phillies’ bullpen. Larry Andersen happens to be an expert on the subject.

articles.title: Phillies reliever Jonathan Bowlan has a right groin strain, but he won’t go on the injured list
articles.description: Bowlan, the Phillies' primary setup man, says this injury isn't as "extreme" as the one he suffered in April, and interim manager Don Mattingly explained why they're leaving him on the active roster.

articles.title: With Jesús Luzardo out, Phillies hitters need to start earning their millions
articles.description: The bullpen, baserunning, and defense are a mess and Jesus Luzardo is out. But the starting pitching is still good. Bryce Harper, Kyle Schwarber, Trea Turner, J.T. Realmuto need to step up now.

articles.title: What to watch for as the playoffs loom: Phillies counting on Alex McFarlane, starters as relievers, and more
articles.description: With their magic number down to three, a fifth straight postseason is in sight for the Phillies. But there are plenty of questions going into the final homestand of the regular season.

articles.title: ‘Phillies Extra’ Q&A: Former GM Matt Klentak on acquiring two aces, and missing out on another
articles.description: A senior advisor in Milwaukee, Klentak has been a part of four straight division titles with the Brewers. But his fingerprints can still be found on the Phillies’ roster.

articles.title: Zack Wheeler delivers seven scoreless innings in Phillies’ shutout of the Nationals: ‘They’re all must-win’
articles.description: Wheeler allowed just four hits and struck out five. The Phillies' offense worked a season-high 13 walks, but left 14 on base.
